This site is where I learn AI Engineering in public. I'm a data scientist and
team lead making the move, and every page here is written in my own words as I
go. Pages stand alone: start anywhere, and follow the prerequisites linked at
the top of a page when you need them.

## The path

The **path** is the default order I'm learning in. It is a sequence of
**stages**, and each stage covers one **theme**: a named area of AI Engineering
such as evals. Some themes have no stage; I learn them alongside the others.
Order is a default, not a rule.

To follow it, open the [Path](path.qmd). To see what changed since your last
visit, open [Recent](recent.qmd). The navbar also has a page per theme and a
page per type of page (topics, dictionary, essays, prototypes, tools).

## Two lenses

Every topic is written through two **lenses**. The **Practitioner** lens is
doing the engineering: the concept, explained with runnable code. The
**Leader** lens is leading the people who do it, and each topic page ends with
a "Leading this" section. Some topics also get a standalone leader page, linked
from the topic page it builds on.
